searchText: The more forks, the more interops in amazing places Sorrry, there are only so many 30 hour flights a year I can do. Especially when the last leg gets a 5 hour delay. Anything exciting in Pectra that improves user experiences, L1 or L2? Blob capacity is under utilized, L2 sequencers charge high fee, so PeerDAS does not matter in the current situation to further bring down tx fees
